scope: Event Record, Journal, target-object identity, action, event time, and existing Updated At declarations. Only selected registered Drafts and the known Current CA-R-2234 were inspected.

known_schema.semantics: Persistent description of an event and its recorded evidence; distinct from the event and does not prove outcome.
known_schema.schema_limit: Only the Journal container is declared here. No target-object relation, action field/relation, or event-time field is present.

known_schema.existing_claim: Required string scalar; unique among Event Records; immutable.
known_schema.schema_limit: Record identity does not identify the Atom or Projection affected by the event.

known_schema.existing_claim: Exactly one Journal in the selected context; a Journal contains zero or more Event Records; accepted records are not edited, reordered or removed; corrections append new records.
known_schema.schema_limit: This defines a container and immutable admitted history, but not complete coverage of all qualifying update events.

known_schema.existing_claim: Required string scalar; immutable after first Current or Archived promotion.
known_schema.identity_limit: Atom.ID is stable across versions, so ID alone does not select one exact Atom version.

known_schema.use: Exact Atom instance identity is the (Atom.ID, Atom.Version) pair.
Confirms the exact-version identity pair. A target reference must resolve to an Atom instance with both ID and Version; a raw ID string can conflate versions.

known_schema.existing_claim: ID functionally determines Projection.Form, Named Selection, and Source Of Truth, and those inputs determine ID.
known_schema.use: Projection.ID identifies the logical Projection across rebuilds; the event target should reference that logical instance, not make each rebuild a new Projection identity.

known_schema.existing_claim: Required datetime scalar; records Project-time instant of the accepted edit represented by the Atom; exact no-op retains prior timestamp.
known_schema.schema_limit: No Event Record timestamp field or target binding currently supports deriving this value.

known_schema.existing_claim: Required datetime scalar; identifies the latest completed rebuild represented by the Projection.
known_schema.schema_limit: No Event Record timestamp, target binding, or completed-rebuild event filter currently supports deriving this value.

known_schema.existing_claim: Reusable operational building block; declared execution relation connects it to Step/Substep.
known_schema.schema_limit: It is not an Event Record action field and does not establish an `update` event or its outcome.

known_schema.existing_claim: RUN binds a Step or Substep to an Action for execution.
known_schema.schema_limit: This is workflow execution structure, not an Event Record-to-target or Event Record action/outcome field.

atom_event_reference.not_sufficient: Atom.ID alone or an untyped raw identifier string

projection_event_reference.rebuild_behavior: Updated At describes the latest completed rebuild; a rebuild does not create a new Projection identity.

bounded_current_context.registered_relation_support: No registered Event Record Relation Definition or Event Record target binding is present among the inspected Event Record, Action, and RUN Drafts. Do not repurpose Current RECORDS as a canonical target relation without a separate decision.

known_current_source.relevant_claim: Event Record is a persistent record in one Journal. It can RECORD an actual occurrence, including Workflow Run, and may preserve/describe an Execution.Result. The record is distinct from the occurrence.
known_current_source.limit: This supports occurrence recording but gives no Event Record target Atom/Projection instance, event action, or timestamp. Its existing RECORDS relation target is Workflow Run, not the requested object target.

minimal_missing_schema_surface.minimal_requirement: A typed relation under Event Record Relations that resolves to one existing Node instance. For Atom it must resolve the exact (ID, Version) instance; for Projection it must resolve the stable logical Projection.ID.
minimal_missing_schema_surface.open: Canonical Relation name and endpoint declaration are not established by inspected sources. Do not invent a `.object` field or reuse RECORDS without authority.

minimal_missing_schema_surface.minimal_requirement: A declared action discriminator that distinguishes an update event from other records and supports the chosen accepted/completed outcome policy.
minimal_missing_schema_surface.open: No Event Record action field/relation or registered `update` value appears in inspected schema. Pending user question: is action=update alone sufficient, or must outcome/accepted-complete status also be filtered?

minimal_missing_schema_surface.minimal_requirement: One required datetime per qualifying update/rebuild event, with explicit meaning as the event's Project-time instant.
minimal_missing_schema_surface.open: No Event Record time Property is declared. Do not infer it from Event Record Carrier metadata, Journal order, Atom.Updated At, or Projection.Updated At. Canonical Property name remains undecided.

minimal_missing_schema_surface.minimal_requirement: Specify that the selected Project-context Journal population contains every qualifying event needed by the max calculation and is complete for the target/action/time scope.
minimal_missing_schema_surface.open: Event Record is contained by one Journal and Journal is one ordered table, but neither selected Draft nor CA-R-2234 requires every relevant update/rebuild to be recorded. Max over an incomplete record set can understate Updated At.

minimal_missing_schema_surface.minimal_requirement: Core authority states that target Updated At equals the maximum eligible Event Record time for the exact target identity; Workflow defines which completed/accepted updates are recorded; Engine serializes records and computes the value.
minimal_missing_schema_surface.open: Inspected CFEL Drafts do not define target/action filtering or datetime MAX aggregation. Do not claim runtime derivation exists.

layer_boundary.Core_R: Declare what an Event Record must identify and the invariant connecting qualifying record times to Atom/Projection Updated At.
layer_boundary.Workflow: Specify which mutation/rebuild outcomes produce an accepted qualifying update record; resolve the pending action=update versus outcome filter decision.
layer_boundary.Engine: Implement event capture, exact typed target-reference serialization, event timestamp capture, complete Journal query, and max computation. Implementation does not replace the Core invariant.
